All core services met their availability targets this quarter. The service desk resolved tickets faster than in any quarter since 2024.
Three major incidents affected tenants directly. Two of the three were caused by configuration that drifted from its documented state.

DateServiceImpactDurationRoot cause9 JulTenant portalLogins failed for all tenants1 h 12 minExpired TLS certificate on the identity proxy; renewal job had been disabled during a migration.22 AugRepairs line (telephony)Calls dropped after 30 seconds47 minCarrier routing change, reverted by the carrier.14 SepRent paymentsCard payments delayed, no data lost2 h 05 minDatabase failover stalled on a full transaction log.
Each incident has a completed review, and all eleven follow-up actions are tracked in the problem register.
Alerts now page the on-call engineer only when a user-facing service degrades. The new latency rule for the tenant portal is shown below.

groups: - name: tenant-portal rules: - alert: PortalHighLatency expr: histogram _quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(portal _ request _ seconds _ bucket[5m]))) > 1.5 for: 10m labels: severity: page annotations: summary: "Portal p95 latency above 1.5 s for 10 minutes"
Move of the repairs system to the new data centre
